messages:
marisa_sales: HarborTech POC update — they're hitting our embeddings+rerank flow and seeing 400/429. Their precomputed vectors are 1024 dims; our reranker expects 1536. Need fast path for POC, and someone to confirm security answers for the SCC. cc @oliver_se @nisha_support

oliver_se: Oof. Do we have a copy of the exact API error they got? 400 should show vector_dims_mismatch if it's the dims case. 429 implies rate/quota.

marisa_sales: Sent me this output from their bulk indexer job:
```
POST /v1/embeddings 400
{"error":"vector_dims_mismatch","expected":1536,"got":1024}
```
And later when retrying larger batches:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 30
{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded"}
```

nisha_support: Sounds like two separate issues: encoding model mismatch + batch size causing rate/byte limits. Ask whether their local encoder is a community model (which one/version?) and whether they can re-run embedding jobs.

sam_ml: If they're stuck with 1024 vectors, we have options: (A) re-embed using rwd-embed-1536 -> best quality; (B) temporary alias to rwd-embed-1024 for embedding + rerank but note reranker semantics may differ; (C) on-the-fly upgrade by running an inference pass on each vector to project to 1536 (expensive). For POC, (B) is quickest.

devon_runtime: I pulled their account metrics — spikes coincide with one-shot bulk jobs of ~400 items, payloads ~6MB each. Our frontend enforces max_batch_bytes=2MB for embeddings on hosted; that explains the 429 + Retry-After. Quick mitigations: reduce batch_size to 64-128, enable chunked streaming, or we create a customer alias with a higher quota (but needs org approval).

oliver_se: Sales note: pricing differs by dims. If we route them to 1024, they may pay less — communicate the tradeoff. Also make sure any alias we create is time-limited for POC.

marisa_sales: Customer says they used an internal encoder based on "fast-sim-1024-v1" and it's expensive to re-run now. They're open to trying the routed 1024 endpoint for the POC if it's fast to set up. Also asked whether reranking will work if the ANN index expects 1536.

sam_ml: Reranker: if you feed a 1024 vector into an index built with 1536 vectors you'll get shape errors at index time. If both embedding and index use 1024 it's fine, but mixing dims fails. So we either: re-embed (recommended), or run everything on 1024 (alias + instruct them to re-index), or small bridge transformation (not recommended).

devon_runtime: I can provision an alias endpoint "harbortech-temp-embeds" -> rwd-embed-1024 and a tightly-scoped quota (daily 50k, burst 200). That should avoid 429s for now. ETA ~2 hours. Need their account id and the dataset name so we can attach quotas and billing.

rollout_bot: Requested alias created: harbortech-temp-embeds -> rwd-embed-1024 (alias_id: abl_123abc). Quota: daily=50000, burst=200.

marisa_sales: Forwarded alias info to customer and told them to re-index with the alias if they choose that path. They asked about timeline and whether it affects the security questionnaire (SCC).

nisha_support: For SCC: routing to a different model doesn't change our data handling commitments. I'll update answers: tokens processed by alias are still processed under customer contract, logs retention unchanged. I'll send the updated SCC page to HarborTech. Also mention that PII should not be embedded directly unless they accept token retention policy.

marisa_sales: Also a pricing ask: HarborTech wants to compare cost of re-embedding (compute + time) vs using alias. I put together a quick calc: re-embed 1M docs at 1536 might take X hours and cost ~$Y; alias with 1024 is cheaper per-request but may reduce rerank quality.

oliver_se: Good. One more operational ask: add a short runbook blurb for them to avoid 429s: use batch_size<=128, enable exponential backoff with Retry-After, and check response headers for remaining_quota.

sam_ml: I'll add a small note about evaluation: run an A/B on a 1k subset comparing their 1024 pipeline vs our 1536 rerank quality using our eval harness. That will quantify impact.

devon_runtime: Alias is live and throttled. I'm leaving it time-limited till EOD (will auto-delete in 72h). If they want extended POC window we escalate to infra for sustained quota.

marisa_sales: Perfect — I'll close the loop with HarborTech and log the POC decision. Thanks team.

nisha_support: I'll upload the SCC changes and ping legal to sign off on the temporary alias config. :white_check_mark:
